title: Map unavailable downstream services to 503 uniformly
body:
When the account service was down, the transaction service used to return 500 with a stack trace fragment. This PR makes outbound clients translate connection failures, timeouts and non-2xx responses into `RemoteServiceException`, which global exception handling maps to `503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE`. Downstream 404 and 409 are still passed through with their original meaning.

## Validation

- New `TransactionControllerTest` case: returns 503 when the account service is unavailable.
- Stopped account-service and manually verified that the bill payment page shows "Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later".
author: Zhao Ning
